meta.title: Secrets Vault
meta.description: Store credentials in an encrypted vault and control agent access.

ui.recoveryHelp: Enter your recovery key and choose a new master password. The old recovery key will be replaced. Existing credential permissions stay unchanged.
ui.recoveryEnableHelp: Confirm your current master password. This enables recovery and changes the encryption format. Back up vault.v2.json and vault.v2.json.recovery.json together while the vault is locked. This pair is required even when using your password.
ui.recoveryRotateHelp: Confirm your master password to replace the recovery key. The previous recovery key will stop working with the current vault.
ui.recoveryIssuedHelp: Shown only now, never in chat or agent tools. Save it outside Harness. Anyone with this key and the vault files can recover your credentials. Old copies of vault files cannot be revoked.
ui.recoveryBackup: Backups now require both vault.v2.json and vault.v2.json.recovery.json from the same locked vault.
ui.recoveryAck: I have saved this recovery key outside Harness.
ui.recoveryFailure: The result may already be committed. Refresh and unlock using the master password you just entered, then use Replace recovery key to get a new key. The previous recovery key may no longer work. Preserve both vault files.
ui.commandDescription: Add a credential privately in Secrets Vault.
ui.subtitle: Store credentials and control agent access.
ui.lockedHelp: Unlock to view and manage your credentials.
ui.setupIntro: Create an encrypted vault for your credentials.
ui.setupHelp: Choose a unique master passphrase. You will need it after Harness restarts. Save the recovery key shown next separately, outside Harness. Without the password or that key, the vault cannot be recovered.
ui.unlockHelp: Unlock once for this Harness process. Screen lock does not interrupt agents. There is no inactivity timer.
ui.nontrivial: Avoid repeated characters and common or predictable passwords. Length alone does not guarantee strength.
ui.emptyHelp: Add a token, account password, or SSH key. Only descriptions are shared with agents — never the secret itself.
ui.name: Name
ui.secretHelp: Sent directly to the vault, not to the chat. Saved secrets are never shown again.
ui.replaceHelp: Leave this off to keep the existing secret. Replacement requires entering the complete new secret.
ui.allowAgentUse: Allow agents to use this credential
ui.scopeHelp: Allow agents to use this credential only for the HTTPS origin / SSH host configured here. Secrets are never returned to agents.
ui.sshHelp: Agent SSH access requires an existing verified known_hosts entry. For an encrypted private key, enter its passphrase here; it stays private.
ui.httpHelp: Tokens use Bearer authentication. Account passwords use HTTP Basic authentication over HTTPS.
ui.sessionHelp: Share this credential’s description with the current conversation
ui.metadataOnly: Keep secret values out of names, descriptions, URLs, and tags. This metadata may be visible to agents.
ui.deleteHelp: This permanently removes the saved credential from the vault. It does not revoke access at the service.
ui.networkError: Could not reach the vault. Check the connection and try again.
ui.requestError: The vault could not complete this request. Please try again.
ui.invalidPassword: Use at least 12 characters and make sure both passwords match.
ui.invalidScope: Agent access requires an HTTPS URL without a username or password.
ui.conflictError: This credential changed in another session. Refresh the list and reopen it before saving.
ui.legacyError: A legacy Vault was found. Preserve the old files and use the previous plugin. Automatic migration is not supported.
ui.busyError: The Vault is owned by another Host or has a stale ownership marker. Close the other Host; preserve the files before maintenance. Never remove a marker while a Host might be running.
ui.uncertainError: The write outcome is uncertain. Preserve the vault files and restart the Host before further operations.
ui.externalError: Vault files changed externally. Access stopped to avoid overwriting data. Preserve and inspect the files before restarting the Host.
ui.closedError: The vault is shutting down. Try again after restarting Harness.
ui.ownershipError: Vault ownership changed. Preserve the files and stop other Hosts before restarting. Never remove a marker while a Host might be running.
ui.unsafePathError: The vault path or permissions are unsafe. Preserve the files and inspect the path and permissions before retrying.
